title: Weber — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Weber.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Original Grill." Weber is the most recognized grill brand in the world — founded in 1952 when George Stephen cut a marine buoy in half and invented the kettle grill. The Genesis and Summit gas lines, SmokeFire pellet grill, and the iconic Original Kettle define outdoor cooking. Weber Connect smart technology adds WiFi monitoring.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Every grilling customer. First-time grill buyers to enthusiasts. The safe, trusted recommendation.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Weber:

• Most recognized grill brand in the world — the name people know

• Original Kettle is an icon — 70+ years of charcoal perfection

• SmokeFire pellet grill brought Weber into the pellet market

• Weber Connect smart technology monitors cook from your phone

• Widest range of price points — from $30 portable to $3,000 Summit
